name: LinkedIn Content Engine
description: Generates a complete batch of 5 LinkedIn posts (2 TOFU, 2 MOFU, 1 BOFU) following Evan's voice and Quely brand guidelines.
inputs: Topic direction, any reference content, week/date for scheduling

name: Evan Thought Leadership
description: Writes LinkedIn posts that sound like Evan — opinionated, specific, earned — with voice rules and templates.
inputs: Topic, angle, any raw notes or examples

name: LinkedIn Comment
description: Generates knowledgeable LinkedIn comments that sound like a practitioner, not marketing.
inputs: The post text you want to comment on

name: Video Content Repurposing
description: Turns raw video transcripts into complete YouTube upload packages plus LinkedIn captions grounded in Quely product reality.
inputs: Raw video transcript or summary

name: Brand Voice
description: Applies and enforces Quely's communication style across any content.
inputs: Draft content to review or enforce brand voice on

name: Social Content
description: Creates social media content following brand guidelines.
inputs: Topic, platform, goal

name: HeyReach Outbound
description: Analyzes LinkedIn conversation screenshots, generates optimal responses, and flags campaign patterns for Quely outreach.
inputs: LinkedIn conversation screenshot or message text

name: Account Research
description: Researches a company or person and returns actionable sales intel.
inputs: Company name or LinkedIn URL

name: Call Prep
description: Prepares for sales calls with account context, attendee research, and suggested agenda.
inputs: Company name, attendee names, meeting goal

name: Draft Outreach
description: Drafts outreach messages and campaigns for cold and warm prospects.
inputs: Prospect context, sequence stage, goal

name: Partnership Sourcing
description: Runs weekly Pool #1 sourcing block — scrapes Evan's LinkedIn engagers and presents candidates for qualification.
inputs: LinkedIn engager list or Evan's recent post URLs

name: Daily Sales Briefing
description: Generates a daily sales briefing with priorities, follow-ups, and pipeline status.
inputs: Current pipeline state, recent activity

name: LinkedIn Research
description: Researches LinkedIn profiles, companies, posts, and employees using Apify actors.
inputs: LinkedIn URL or company/person name

name: Reddit Research
description: Reads Reddit posts and extracts comments using Playwright browser automation.
inputs: Reddit URL or search query

name: Competitive Intelligence
description: Researches competitors from a sales perspective — positioning, pricing, weaknesses.
inputs: Competitor name or URL

name: Competitive Analysis
description: Builds feature comparison matrices, positioning analysis, and strategic implications.
inputs: Competitors to analyze, focus area

name: Crafting Positioning
description: Positions Quely in the market using April Dunford framework — UVP, messaging, differentiation.
inputs: Current positioning draft or positioning problem to solve

name: Building Communication Engine
description: Chooses GTM channels, plans launch newsletter, sets budget, collects social proof.
inputs: Current GTM stage, target channels

name: Running Marketing
description: Builds ongoing marketing engine — content strategy, social publishing, email sequences, paid ads.
inputs: Current marketing state, focus area

name: Executing Sales
description: Builds sales engine — deck, case studies, outbound campaigns, partnership programs, ABM strategy.
inputs: Sales stage, target accounts or segments

name: Preparing Launch Assets
description: Builds launch assets — website, pitch deck, press release, product demo, media kit.
inputs: Launch type, existing assets, target audience

name: GTM Foundations
description: Builds strategic GTM foundation — OPE canvas, SWOT, value proposition, 90-day plan.
inputs: Product/stage context, current GTM challenges

name: Feature Spec
description: Writes structured PRDs with problem statements, user stories, requirements, and success metrics.
inputs: Feature idea, user problem, success criteria

name: Roadmap Management
description: Plans and prioritizes roadmaps using RICE, MoSCoW, ICE frameworks.
inputs: Feature backlog, current priorities, constraints

name: Stakeholder Comms
description: Drafts stakeholder updates tailored to executives, engineering, partners, and customers.
inputs: Update topic, audience, key points to communicate

name: User Research Synthesis
description: Synthesizes qualitative and quantitative research into actionable insights.
inputs: Raw research notes, interview transcripts, or survey data

name: SQL Queries
description: Writes correct, performant SQL across all major data warehouse dialects.
inputs: Schema description, question to answer with data

name: Data Visualization
description: Creates visualizations and charts from data to communicate insights.
inputs: Data source, question to visualize, preferred chart type
